subject: Region ops runbook integrity & private-link proof request
messages:
From: Security Team <security@bioforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>; Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask: residency + keystore rotation runbook and privatelink proof for EU-only deployment

Hi Marcus / Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our security intake for the EU pilot we need a short set of artifacts to complete our vendor review: 

- A one-page affirmation that production traffic for our tenant will remain in eu-west-1 and that no cross-border egress to outside the EU will occur.
- The ops runbook that describes operator onboarding, bastion/hop access, and the keystore rotation & escrow procedure (we need to see HSM usage and any manual steps).
- A checklist of artifacts we can attach to our SIG/CAIQ submission (evidence filenames are fine).

Would you be able to provide these by end of next week? If there are any known gaps we can accept a timeline and compensating controls.

Best,
Mike Chen
Security Lead, BioForge Therapeutics
security@bioforge.com

--
Attachment: bioforge_intake_template.xlsx (stub)"

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Security Team <security@bioforge.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: residency + keystore rotation runbook and privatelink proof for EU-only deployment

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear ask.

We can provide the one-page affirmation plus a runbook draft and the keystore rotation plan. Quick notes up front:
- We will host the tenant in eu-west-1 for the pilot and will not provision cross-border egress routes for that tenant by default. Where customers request multi-region failover, we document fallback behaviors; those are opt-in.
- Keystore rotations are HSM-backed in the production offering; we maintain an operator escrow process for on-prem/private deployments.

Im attaching a draft runbook and a rotation plan for your review. Olga and Neha are looping in Ops and Compliance to validate the wording and evidence checklist. If you can confirm the exact file names BioForge needs for SIG/CAIQ mapping (e.g., descriptions vs. raw logs), well organize the attachments accordingly.

Proposed timeline: draft artifacts tomorrow (Sept 28), final affirmation and evidence pack by Sept 30.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments referenced: runbook_draft_v1.md; keystore_rotation_plan.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-28T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: residency + keystore rotation runbook and privatelink proof for EU-only deployment

Marcus — thanks, looks good. A couple of internal clarifications before we send to BioForge: 

1) Keystore rotation: confirm the rotation cadence in the draft (we currently do 90-day rotations for ephemeral session keys; master root keys are rotated per-year with HSM-backed rewrap and customer escrow when Private is used). Add an explicit statement that the HSM is CloudHSM (AWS KMS-backed) and that operator key export requires multi-party approval and offline escrow.

2) Bastion/access: include the short-lived cert flow and that operator sessions are recorded for 30 days (we can provide recordings on request under NDA).

3) Privatelink/VPC: we must indicate the private endpoint sits in the customer's VPC peering subnet in eu-west-1. Add network flow diagram (we can produce a slim PNG).

Ive made inline edits in runbook_draft_v1.md and added an internal evidence_checklist.csv (stub) with suggested artifact names. Sending back to you for external send.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

--
Attachment: evidence_checklist.csv (stub)"

From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@bioforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: residency + keystore rotation runbook and privatelink proof for EU-only deployment

Marcus / Olga,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from our InfoSec: 
- The one-page affirmation is helpful — can you include a single explicit sentence that "No production egress from the BioForge tenant will leave the eu-west-1 AWS region unless BioForge has explicitly enabled cross-region replication or failover"? Thats our policy language.
- For SIG mapping, we need filenames and short descriptions (1-2 lines) for: runbook, keystore rotation plan, and network diagram.
- Please redact any internal-only operational comments before we attach items to vendor portal.

If you deliver the one-pager and the renamed artifacts tomorrow well be able to close the pilot intake.

Thanks,
Mike Chen
Security Lead, BioForge Therapeutics

--
Note: Security team request attached: bioforge_required_fields.txt (stub)"

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial ask: residency + keystore rotation runbook and privatelink proof for EU-only deployment

Mike — attached is the one-page affirmation in PDF and the sanitized artifact pack for SIG/CAIQ ingestion. Summary below (for easy mapping):

- onepager_affirmation.pdf: "No production egress from the BioForge tenant will leave the eu-west-1 AWS region unless BioForge has explicitly enabled cross-region replication or failover."
- runbook_final.md: Operator onboarding, bastion access, short-lived cert flow (redacted internal ops notes).
- keystore_rotation_plan.pdf: HSM-backed rotation cadence (master keys: annual; session keys: 90 days), multi-party approval and offline escrow described.
- network_diagram.png: Privatelink endpoint placement and VPC peer flow (eu-west-1 only).

We have kept internal audit artifacts out of the public pack; if you need recordings or raw logs we can provide them under NDA and a dedicated transfer.

Next steps: Ill upload the evidence bundle to the HubSpot attachment and share the link. If everything looks good on your side well mark the intake closed.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
